# [Mandatory] KBYG - Conversion Hotel
Date: 2026-11-12 | Duration: 32m

## Summary
The discussion covered London dinner planning and preparations for Conversion Hotel, scheduled for November 20–22 at Grand Hotel Opduin on Texel, with approximately 150 attendees. The partner package includes an 8-minute main-stage presentation, a 30-minute breakout session, a lobby booth, and scheduled Saturday sessions. The booth will feature a monitor, banner, swag, and an interactive pinball competition, with targets of 10 LinkedIn connections, 5 on-site Calendly meetings, 5 demos by December 6, and 6 opportunities within 60 days. Travel includes a Thursday shuttle at 13:30 and a Sunday return at 14:00; booth move-in is Friday from 11:00 to 13:00. # [Mandatory] KBYG - AWS: re:Invent
Date: 2026-11-17 | Duration: 22m

## Summary
The team prepared for AWS Re:Invent, scheduled for November 30–December 4, with a bronze sponsorship and Booth 1682 at the Venetian. Goals are 90 ICP lead scans, 15 onsite Calendly meetings, 12 demos booked by December 11, and eight new Ops by January 31. The booth will use an Arcade Gaming theme, a custom game, daily AirPods Max 2 raffles, tiered swag, AI workflow signage, and supporting landing-page, HubSpot, communications, and playbook materials. Lyndsie is the onsite lead, with setup due Monday at noon, two to three people staffing the booth, and teardown on Thursday. Lead scanners, qualification categories, and immediate meeting booking are central to conversion; relevant scans must include qualification, notes, and an owner. The team will also network in conference sessions and halls, attend a December 1 dinner at 7:00 p.m., and use the expense memo `AWS re invent 2026`.

## Keywords
AWS re:Invent, Booth activation, Lead scanning, Calendly meetings, Event marketing, Pipeline generation
